reason: I tried magnesium before and honestly felt no difference, so twenty-five pounds a month for something that might do nothing is a lot when I'm on about nineteen thousand a year. I'd put my name on the waitlist to see what other people say, but I wouldn't commit yet.
objection: I've already spent money on magnesium and felt nothing, so why would these be any different? And they've got sugar and glucose syrup in them, which I'm trying to cut down on.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from people my age who felt less tired after a month, or a smaller first purchase so I could try a jar without paying for three.
